# ZetaStore

> Independent reviews of popular health and wellness products: ingredients, pros and cons, price, guarantee, and alternatives.

Each review summarizes the vendor's sales page and label, cites independent sources (NIH, MedlinePlus, PubMed, FDA) on the key ingredients, lists red flags to verify before buying, and states that we have not purchased or tested the product. Pages contain affiliate links, disclosed at the top.
